source: https://deadbydaylight.wiki.gg/wiki/Realms (plus per-realm and per-map pages, and Category:Realms / Category:Maps)

notes: Category:Realms lists exactly 21 pages, matching the Realms overview page's stated 'currently 21 Realms'.

Category:Maps lists 47 pages. The 47th is 'The Mall', an announced-but-unreleased map (see uncertain entry below) not yet counted in the live '46 Maps' total, so 46 + 1 upcoming = 47 category pages. This reconciles cleanly.

The Realms overview page also contains a leftover/stale trivia sentence saying a new Realm+Map are 'upcoming' in CHAPTER 39: All-Kill: Comeback. Chapter 39 has in fact already shipped (17 March 2026, Patch 9.5.0) and added the Sleepless District realm with its one map, Trickster's Delusion -- both of which are already included in the live 21/46 totals used above. The 'upcoming' wording appears to be un-updated wiki text rather than a real pending addition; treated as resolved, not as a 22nd realm.

Per-realm infobox fields called 'Number of Maps' (e.g. MacMillan Estate=13, Autohaven Wreckers=9, Coldwind Farm=8, Crotus Prenn Asylum=4) are LARGER than the named-map counts used here and than the Realms-page total. These appear to count granular 'Map Variations' (layout/prop variants of the same named map), a different unit than the named Maps this dataset tracks. They were NOT used for counting; the named-map lists (which do reconcile to 46) were used instead. Flagged for awareness, not treated as a mismatch.

realms.name: The MacMillan Estate
realms.note: Wiki's own Beta/history text confirms MacMillan Estate, Autohaven Wreckers and Coldwind Farm were the three 'Release-Realms' present at launch. The realm's infobox oddly also lists 'Associated Chapter(s): CHAPTER 27: Tools of Torment' and 'Release Patch: 6.6.0' -- this almost certainly reflects a later killer-association/visual-rework note (Skull Merchant became linked to this realm) rather than the realm's introduction, since MacMillan Estate demonstrably predates Chapter 27 by years. That specific infobox field is flagged uncertain; realm identity, launch status and map list are high confidence.

realms.name: Withered Isle
realms.chapter: CHAPTER 24: Roots of Dread (Patch 6.0.0) for founding map; expanded by CHAPTER 31: All Things Wicked (Patch 7.6.0), CHAPTER 36: Five Nights at Freddy's (Patch 9.0.0), and 'The Walking Dead' chapter (Patch 9.1.0)
realms.note: This realm accumulated 4 maps across 4 separate chapters rather than launching complete. The exact chapter number for 'The Walking Dead' chapter (source of Fallen Refuge, Patch 9.1.0) was not verified -- only the chapter name and patch were confirmed directly. It is unclear from available text whether Garden of Joy/Greenville Square were originally separate standalone realms later merged into Withered Isle, or whether Withered Isle always was the umbrella realm for new additions; current structure (4 named maps under Withered Isle) is confirmed, but this historical merge detail is uncertain.

realms.name: Sleepless District
realms.note: Realm and its one map (Trickster's Delusion) were physically added together in Chapter 39. The realm infobox also lists CHAPTER 19: All-Kill (Trickster's original 2021 debut chapter) as an 'associated chapter', which appears to be thematic/lore linkage to the killer rather than the map's actual introduction date -- Trickster's Delusion's own page states it was released in Patch 9.5.0.

maps.name: Badham Preschool
maps.note: Listed by the wiki as a single named Map that has several historical visual/layout variations (e.g. different in-game 'years'); those variations are not treated as separate named Maps here, consistent with the Realms overview and Category:Maps pages both listing it once.

maps.name: Raccoon City Police Station
maps.note: The original, full-size map. Retired from standard ranked rotation in Patch 6.2.0 in favor of the East Wing / West Wing split below, but returned exclusively for 2v8 mode in Patch 8.5.1. Still exists as its own Map page/entity per the realm's infobox (states 3 total maps), so counted here, but flagged medium confidence because its current 'active' status is mode-dependent rather than universal.
